A free course for Grade 5 and up

Learn to code by making games and art.

Three friendly levels, one 60-minute session a week. Children start with Scratch blocks and grow into real Python, with projects they care about. Parents do not need to know how to code.

  • No accounts or sign-ups

Where would you like to start?

For parents

What the research says, what a session looks like, how to help at home, and your questions answered. Includes the information-evening slides.

For students

Pick a level, open this week's page, build the exercises and tick off your progress. Hints appear one at a time.

Three levels at a glance

Each level is 10 to 12 weeks long with one session a week, and ends with a project you design and share.

Level 1

Introduction

Start from zero. Snap together Scratch blocks, then type your first lines of Python.

Final project: My Interactive Art Show

Level 2

Intermediate

Write real Python: functions, lists, files, tests and your own games.

Final project: Arcade Game or Art Studio

Level 3

Advanced

Build something big with classes, algorithms, git and a first look at how AI learns.

Final project: Build Something Big

See the full roadmap and timeline · Setup guides, cheat sheets and glossary

What a session looks like

  1. Warm-up A quick game, often without a computer.
  2. New idea One idea, explained with a picture or an analogy.
  3. Watch and try A short live demo, then your turn.
  4. Build in pairs Driver and navigator swap often.
  5. Show and tell Share what you made, tick the check-list.

Kids Coding

A free course for children from Grade 5: make games and art, first with Scratch blocks, then with Python. One 60-minute session a week.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
